questions.question: Temple of Doom is set in which year relative to Raiders of the Lost Ark?
questions.note: Temple is 1935; Raiders is 1936. It is a prequel, even though it was the second film released.

questions.question: Who plays Short Round, Indy’s kid sidekick in Temple of Doom?
questions.note: Later an Oscar winner for Everything Everywhere All at Once. The credits used Jonathan Ke Quan.

questions.question: Who plays nightclub singer Willie Scott in Temple of Doom?
questions.note: She later married Steven Spielberg. The opening number is “Anything Goes,” in Mandarin, at Club Obi Wan.

questions.question: What sacred objects is Mola Ram after in Temple of Doom?
questions.note: Five legendary stones. Indy returns most of them to the village. Amrish Puri plays Mola Ram.

questions.question: Who plays Indy’s father, Henry Jones Sr., in The Last Crusade?
questions.note: James Bond as Indy’s dad. The joke writes itself, and the movie knows it.

questions.question: Who plays a teenage Indiana Jones in the opening of The Last Crusade?
questions.note: A circus train, a magic trick, and the first fedora. Phoenix was also Ford’s on-screen son in The Mosquito Coast.

questions.question: In The Last Crusade, the real Holy Grail looks like what?
questions.note: The knight says “He chose poorly” when Donovan drinks from the flashy one. Indy picks the cup of a carpenter.

questions.question: In the Last Crusade letter trap, which spelling of the name of God makes the floor collapse?
questions.note: In Latin, the name starts with I, not J. Indy almost goes in the hole, then catches himself.

questions.question: In The Last Crusade, what does Henry Sr. say they named the family dog?
questions.note: So Indy is named after the dog. Ford’s “This is history” lecture does not survive contact with Dad.

questions.question: Who plays Dr. Elsa Schneider, the art historian in The Last Crusade?
questions.note: She works both sides. Julian Glover is Walter Donovan, who drinks from the wrong cup.
